blocks.tamil_translation: He forbids; He admonishes you (with this) so that you may keep it in mind.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- This verse is said to be a verse that encompasses many of the teachings of the Qur'an. In this verse three commands are given: 1. to act with justice, 2. to do good, 3. to treat relatives well. Three things are forbidden: 1. shamelessness, 2. every kind of evil deed, 3. injustice. For a person to become one who has good qualities himself and to wish good for others, going beyond even the level of justice into kindness, forgiveness and gentle dealing, is another name for Ihsan.
(Tafsir Usmani)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ: اَلْوَالِدُ اَوْسَطُ اَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ، فَاِنْ شِئْتَ فَاَضِعْ ذلِكَ الْبَابَ اَوِ احْفَظْهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث صحيح باب ماجاء من الفضل في رضا الوالدين رقم:١٩٠٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Darda (RA) narrates that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “The father is the best of the gates of Jannah; (by disobeying him and hurting his heart) destroy that gate! Or (by obeying him and pleasing him) protect that gate.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ﵄ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: رِضَا الرَّبِّ فِيْ رِضَا الْوَالِدِ، وَسَخَطُ الرَّبِّ فِيْ سَخَطِ الْوَالِدِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه التر مذي باب ماجاء من الفضل في رضا الوالدين رقم:١٨٩٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “The pleasure of Allah Ta'ala lies in the pleasure of the father, and the displeasure of Allah Ta'ala lies in the displeasure of the father”, Rasulullah ﷺ said, as Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr (RA)
